title: Robust Metaheuristics under Uncertainty for Berth Allocation and Quay Crane Assignment: A Review
abstract: arXiv:2608.19214v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The berth allocation and quay crane assignment problem (BACAP) is a representative port-terminal scheduling problem in maritime transportation and freight logistics, where vessel arrivals, berth positions, service durations, and quay?crane availability are tightly coupled. Under uncertainties such as arrival deviations, handling-time fluctuations, and resource disruptions, schedules optimized under nominal assumptions may become fragile during execution, motivating the study of robust metaheuristic optimization for BACAP in port-terminal operations. Although population-based metaheuristics have been widely used for BACAP and related port-scheduling problems, existing studies remain fragmented in their uncertainty repre?sentations, robustness criteria, search mechanisms, and empir?ical evaluation protocols. To the best of our knowledge, this paper provides the first focused review dedicated to robust population-based metaheuristics for BA

translated_title: 不确定条件下鲁棒元启发式算法在泊位分配与岸桥调度中的应用：综述
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19214v1 公告类型：新 摘要：泊位分配与岸桥调度问题（BACAP）是海上运输和货运物流中典型的港口码头调度问题，其中船舶到达、泊位位置、服务时长和岸桥可用性紧密耦合。在到达偏差、装卸时间波动和资源中断等不确定性下，基于名义假设优化的调度方案在执行过程中可能变得脆弱，这促使了对港口码头运营中BACAP鲁棒元启发式优化的研究。尽管基于种群的元启发式算法已广泛应用于BACAP及相关港口调度问题，但现有研究在不确定性表示、鲁棒性标准、搜索机制和实证评估协议方面仍较为分散。据我们所知，本文首次专门综述了针对BA的鲁棒种群元启发式算法。
tldr: 本文首次系统综述了不确定条件下针对泊位分配与岸桥调度问题的鲁棒元启发式算法，填补了该领域缺乏综合评述的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first focused review of robust metaheuristics for berth allocation and quay crane assignment under uncertainty, filling a gap in comprehensive surveys of this area.
